cases.prompt: I want to find out why my MacBook Pro (M3, macOS 15) gets hot and loud during video calls. Build a local collector that samples CPU load, memory pressure, thermal state, and battery power draw every 10 seconds, keeps 30 days of data, and stays under 1% average CPU and 50 MB of disk. Swift is fine. Nothing should leave the machine. I want to query it later with sqlite3 to correlate thermal state with the hours I spend in calls.
sourceAnchors: Write timestamped samples to SQLite with WAL, prepared statements, schema versioning, retention cleanup, and bounded transactions.
Package a user LaunchAgent with explicit paths and logs.

requiredEvidence: thermal state from a supported interface
measured collector overhead against the 1% budget
forbiddenActions: uploaded metrics to a remote server
